description: This file defines a React component for a detailed 'Roadmap Journey' page within a career development platform. It includes UI elements for visualizing career pathways: an interactive mind map with expandable categories and sub-nodes, and a progress timeline with milestones. The code also contains utility functions, data seeders, and subcomponents for rendering complex visualizations and managing application state related to roles, milestones, and pathways.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a string array with safety checks for malformed data.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix, using random and timestamp components.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: progressRingTone
methods.description: Determines ring colors based on percentage progress.

methods.name: computeStageForIndex
methods.description: Assigns a stage label ('now', 'near', 'next') based on index position relative to total milestones.

methods.name: normalizeMilestonesForPathway
methods.description: Ensures milestone objects have stage and tags set appropriately, distributing undefined values based on position.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a seed RolePlan object with default data for a given roleId, including sample milestones.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads roadmap state (active role and plans) from localStorage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to localStorage.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: React hook to detect if user has requested reduced motion for accessibility.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Builds role-specific categories and sub-nodes for the mind map visualization based on role ID and title.

calls: cornerstone-functions like React.useState, React.useEffect, React.useMemo, React.useCallback
